parts.text: Which plan best supports good health?

options.text: Skipping sleep to finish more videos each night.
Eating balanced meals, sleeping on time, playing outdoors, and keeping his desk area clean and safe.
Choosing only the sweetest snacks because they taste best.
Cleaning the classroom floor while leaving broken, unsafe furniture in place.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Siddharth wants daily habits and surroundings that support a healthy body and a healthy mind. He compares four plans for the school week.

part_answers.answer: Health needs food, sleep, activity, and clean safe surroundings together, not late screens, sweets alone, or cleaning that ignores unsafe places.

teacher.key_rationale: Balanced food, rest, activity, and clean safe surroundings support body and mind. Late videos, sweets alone, or ignoring unsafe furniture do not.
